stem_md:
$x=x(y,z),\ y=y(x,z),\ z=z(x,y)$ 都是由方程 $F(x,y,z)=0$ 所确定的具有连续偏导数的函数，则
\[
\frac{\partial x}{\partial y}\cdot\frac{\partial y}{\partial z}\cdot\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=(\quad)
\]
analysis_md:
$F(x,y,z)=0$ 可确定隐函数 $z=z(x,y)$，

则：$F'_x(x,y,z)=0\Rightarrow F'_1(x,y,z)\cdot1+F'_2(x,y,z)\cdot0+F'_3(x,y,z)\cdot z_x=0$

得：$z_x=-\frac{F'_1(x,y,z)}{F'_3(x,y,z)}$

同理可以推出：$y'_z=-\frac{F'_3(x,y,z)}{F'_2(x,y,z)}$，$x'_y=-\frac{F'_2(x,y,z)}{F'_1(x,y,z)}$

则 $\frac{\partial x}{\partial y}\cdot\frac{\partial y}{\partial z}\cdot\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=z'_xy'_zx'_z=-1$

\[
\frac{\partial x}{\partial y}\cdot\frac{\partial y}{\partial z}\cdot\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=(\quad)
\] $0$ $2$ $-1$ $1$ $F(x,y,z)=0$ 可确定隐函数 $z=z(x,y)$，

则：$F'_x(x,y,z)=0\Rightarrow F'_1(x,y,z)\cdot1+F'_2(x,y,z)\cdot0+F'_3(x,y,z)\cdot z_x=0$

得：$z_x=-\frac{F'_1(x,y,z)}{F'_3(x,y,z)}$

同理可以推出：$y'_z=-\frac{F'_3(x,y,z)}{F'_2(x,y,z)}$，$x'_y=-\frac{F'_2(x,y,z)}{F'_1(x,y,z)}$

则 $\frac{\partial x}{\partial y}\cdot\frac{\partial y}{\partial z}\cdot\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=z'_xy'_zx'_z=-1$
